_meta.note: Integrate the v1.13 review-evidence hardening (from the hardened-beta zip) into our dual-runtime version, SYMMETRICALLY. Node = spec (T45/T46 = baseline). Then mirror to Python, restore TRUE parity (new audit rules + fixtures that exercise them), enforce identity (executor stamps distinct actors), and fix two bugs (gate.sh unicode marks; calibrate side_effecting). Gate cmds are behavioral and non-side-effecting so this plan passes hb-audit.

tasks.title: Author T45/T46 + update review call-sites
tasks.description: Port the hardened build's T45 (hollow floor, artifact-required, thin/substantive, artifact rot, side_effecting, RANDOM) and T46 (anchor-citation, self-review identity) into tests/run-tests.sh, and update existing review pass call-sites (T24, T29) to use --artifact.

tasks.title: gate.sh hollow floor + fix marks
tasks.description: Add a runtime hollow-gate floor to plugin/templates/gate.sh (a zero-criteria gate FAILS), using literal check marks consistent with the rest of the file (not the buggy \u escapes).

tasks.title: hb.js review-evidence + doctor + actor
tasks.description: In plugin/templates/hb.js: add HB_ACTOR → actor field on events; make hb review pass require --artifact (>=40 chars), cite phase anchors (gate id / task ids / gate-referenced paths), and reject a self-review (reviewer == doer); store the artifact under .hb/reviews/; add a doctor check that a review_passed keeps a readable backing artifact; update the review PROTOCOL text.

tasks.title: hb-audit.js side_effecting + nondet
tasks.description: In plugin/templates/hb-audit.js: expand the nondeterminism pattern (RANDOM, shuf, /dev/urandom, SECONDS, $$, mktemp, date) and add a side_effecting rule (a gate criterion that writes/creates files fabricates its own evidence) — calibrated to ignore /dev/null and /tmp scratch.

tasks.title: hb-exec.js driver compliance + identity
tasks.description: In plugin/templates/hb-exec.js: on a refuter pass, require substantive findings, persist them under .hb/reviews/ and pass --artifact (escalate on an empty pass); stamp distinct HB_ACTOR for the worker vs the refuter so the self-review guard is enforced in the automated path.

tasks.title: Author py tests + parity fixtures
tasks.description: Add py/tests/test_hardening.py (artifact required/thin/anchor/self-review, doctor artifact-rot, gate hollow floor, audit side_effecting) and add planning/audit-fixtures/side-effect.json; wire the new fixture into tests/parity.sh so parity exercises the new audit rules.

tasks.title: Mirror state/gate/audit
tasks.description: Mirror into the port: state.py (actor field from HB_ACTOR), gate.py (zero-criteria hollow floor), audit.py (expanded NONDET + side_effecting rule identical to node).

tasks.title: Mirror review + doctor + protocol
tasks.description: Mirror into cli.py (hb review pass --artifact + anchor + self-review + store), doctor.py (review-artifact rot), and protocol.py (review action text).

tasks.title: Mirror executor + call-sites
tasks.description: Mirror into executor.py (persist refuter findings, --artifact, escalate on empty, distinct actors) and update the python review call-sites (test_exec, test_review stubs) to the artifact form.

tasks.title: Restore true parity
tasks.description: Extend tests/parity.sh to compare node vs python audit on the side-effect fixture, so a future divergence in the new rules is caught. Confirm node == python across all fixtures.

tasks.title: Docs + invariant
tasks.description: Document the review-evidence contract in plugin/skills/heartbeat/SKILL.md, add the review-evidence invariant to AGENTS.md, and add a v1.13 section to STATUS.md.

tasks.title: Version + package
tasks.description: Bump plugin/.claude-plugin/plugin.json and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json to 1.13.0 and py/pyproject.toml to 0.5.0 (update the version-bump test), then rebuild and extract-test the package.

review.prompt: Refute that HP0 is done: can a phase still advance on a self-asserted review pass? Does the artifact gate reduce to real evidence, or can a padded/filler artifact pass? Is the self-review guard actually enforced in the executor path (distinct actors), or opt-in only? Does a zero-criteria gate really fail at runtime? Are T45/T46 hollow (asserting the stub, not the guard)?
